text:
jules_sales: Hey @tori_ps, quick ask — Orbit Labs POC looks like 3-months, expected ~30M tokens, wants API + Optimize + Console add-on. They're asking for a cross-product package with 20% off list and $20k platform credits. Can we approve for a $40k commit? Need deal desk signoff to push quote.

tori_ps: Can you paste expected usage breakout (API tokens / embeddings / Optimize evals) and confirm contract length? Also any security questionnaire flags?

jules_sales: Usage est: API ~24M tokens, Embeddings ~4M, Optimize evals ~50k, Console seats 3. Term: 3 months (POC) with option to convert. Quick rate snippet for calc: 
```
API list: $0.002/token
Embeddings: $0.0005/embedding
Optimize: $0.10/eval
Console seats: $50/mo
```

kevin_pmo: From deal desk — 20% cross-product is above the standard cap. Need a margin calc, deal-request form filled, and an approved promo code. Please submit: https://corp.redwood/deals 

anita_revenueops: Heads up — existing cross-sell policy caps discounts at 15% without VP signoff. Console add-on discounts limited to 10%. Any >15% needs RevOps or Finance approval.

jules_sales: If they prepay $40k upfront, expected recognized rev over 3mo = $40k. Rough cost estimate (infra + support) ~$6k, implies ~85% gross margin. Does that justify >15%?

kevin_pmo: Put those numbers into the deal form. If gross margin >70% we can approve up to 18% with a notification to VP. For 20% we need explicit VP signoff. Can someone ping @sasha_vp_revenue?

nate_ml: Technical note — POC will require a dedicated dev environment and VPC peering. Security questionnaire flagged inbound IP allowlist and data retention policy. We need a signed DPA + SOC attestation before any production data. Estimate +5-7 business days for security gating.

jules_sales: Got it — I'll update the deal form and security checklist. Can we get temporary pre-approval to present an 18% quote and $15k credit to move the conversation? Will escalate if they push for 20%.

sasha_vp_revenue: (joined) I can approve 20% only if they prepay $40k and sign a 12-month auto-renewal with favorable renewal pricing. For a 3-month POC only, approve 18% + $15k credit. :ok_hand:

kevin_pmo: Noted — marking deal as "conditionally approved" pending DPA + signed T&Cs. Use promo code PREPAY-CROSS-18 for the quote.

jules_sales: Great — I'll send quote with 18% off and $15k platform credit, and call out the 5-7 business day security gating. Will escalate to Sasha if client insists on 20%. Thanks all :pray:

cicd-bot: Quote pipeline: applied template `quote-template-v2` to Orbit Labs deal (id: ORBIT-2026-001).
